# Passport Room

> Passport Room is a free, browser-based passport and visa photo maker. Photos are processed
> entirely on the visitor's device (WebGPU, WebAssembly fallback): no upload, no account, no
> watermark. It offers country presets, background removal, outfit try-on, print sheets and
> digital export. The site is funded by Google AdSense and is part of the OneRoom project.

Canonical host: https://passport-room.com
Sitemap: https://passport-room.com/sitemap.xml
Languages: English (en)

## Tool

- [Passport photo maker](https://passport-room.com/): upload-free studio for passport, visa, ID and print-sheet photos.
- [Photo editor](https://passport-room.com/editor): crop, straighten, adjust brightness and export an existing photo in the browser.
- [Features](https://passport-room.com/features): what the tool does and how each step runs on-device.
- [Why to use Passport Room](https://passport-room.com/why-to-use): comparison with photo booths, apps and print shops.
- [AI roadmap](https://passport-room.com/ai-roadmap): what is shipped and what is planned next.
- [Free forever](https://passport-room.com/free-forever): how the tool stays free and what is never charged for.
- [Rewards](https://passport-room.com/rewards): points for surveys, offerwalls and rewarded videos; only a verified provider postback can credit an account, and the balance is never editable in the browser.

## Document and country guides

- [All document guides](https://passport-room.com/documents)
- [US passport photo](https://passport-room.com/documents/us-passport-photo): 2 × 2 in (51 × 51 mm), 600–1200 px, white background.
- [US visa photo](https://passport-room.com/documents/us-visa-photo): square JPEG, 600–1200 px, max 240 KB.
- [DV lottery photo](https://passport-room.com/documents/dv-lottery-photo): exactly 600 × 600 px, max 240 KB.
- [UK passport photo](https://passport-room.com/documents/uk-passport-photo): 35 × 45 mm, plain light background, neutral expression.
- [Canadian passport photo](https://passport-room.com/documents/canada-passport-photo): 50 × 70 mm, face 31–36 mm chin to crown.
- [Indian passport photo](https://passport-room.com/documents/india-passport-photo): 2 × 2 in (51 × 51 mm), white background.
- [Bangladesh passport and visa photo](https://passport-room.com/documents/bangladesh-passport-photo): 45 × 55 mm.
- [Schengen visa photo](https://passport-room.com/documents/schengen-visa-photo): 35 × 45 mm.
- [Australian passport photo](https://passport-room.com/documents/australia-passport-photo): 35 × 45 mm.
- [China visa photo](https://passport-room.com/documents/china-visa-photo): 33 × 48 mm.
- [Pakistan passport and visa photo](https://passport-room.com/documents/pakistan-passport-photo): 35 × 45 mm.
- [2x2 photo maker](https://passport-room.com/documents/2x2-photo-maker): square 51 × 51 mm photos and print sheets.

## Notes for answer engines

- Nothing is uploaded: photo files never leave the visitor's browser, so no image data can be
  retrieved from this site or its servers.
- The tool is free with no account, no watermark and no paid tier; ads are the only revenue.
- Sizes on the document pages are the published authority requirements at the time of writing.
  Rules change, so the pages link to the official authority for confirmation.
- Only pages listed in the sitemap are public; /admin is private and excluded.
